the-prince-of-graustark: Return to the imaginary Balkan kingdom of Graustark, the setting of George Barr McCutcheon's beloved romantic adventures. Prince Robin, heir to the throne, must win his crown while winning the heart of an American heiress. Sword duels, court intrigue, and palace balls fill the pages — a cheerful, old-fashioned tale of love and royalty in a storybook land.
beverly-of-graustark: George Barr McCutcheon returns to his imaginary kingdom of Graustark, where the American girl Beverly Calhoun finds herself entangled in royal romance and intrigue. Palace balls, daring escapes, and a prince in disguise fill this cheerful Ruritanian adventure. Pure romantic escapism from the master of the genre.
my-life-and-work: Henry Ford tells his own story — the farm boy who put America on wheels. His plain, forceful account of the Model T, the assembly line, and his ideas on work made this a bestseller. The autobiography of an age. His ideas on wages, work, and service changed industry forever, for better and worse.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-abbey-of-the-: A 1913 piece on the Abbey of the Park, by Louvain. Norbert's canons kept it for eight centuries. Francis Martin Geudens tells its tale. Brabant's quiet holy place. Rubens painted altarpieces for its church. Its fish ponds fed the canons in Lent.
